title: Headcount ramp sync - scratch
content:
Purpose: working notes to prep the weekly headcount ramp sync with Eng PLs + People Ops. Focus: immediate requisitions, interview loop fixes blocking offers, and two-week execution runs for ramping 8 ICs in Q1.

Context / quick numbers:
- Goal: hire 8 ICs across Platform (4), Serving Runtime (2), and Developer DX (2) by end of Q1.
- Current offers out: 3 (1 Platform, 2 DevDX) — 1 verbal accept pending comp approval.
- Candidates in loop: 12 active (5 onsites / final loops, 7 earlier stages).
- Req approvals pending with Finance: 2 (Platform backend x2).
- Interviewer capacity: engineering interviewers down ~15% due to holidays + on-call rotations.

Top agenda items for sync (my notes):
1) Reqs & approvals (5m)
   - PRI: unblock Finance for Platform backend reqs. Action: Priya to escalate and get back by Thu EOD.
   - Confirm compensation bands for Platform senior IC (comp band change note in Confluence).
2) Interview loop hygiene (10m)
   - Problem: Serving Runtime loop has inconsistent rubric for system design (too backend-focused, not inference-specific).
   - Proposal: add focused prompt + rubric item for "inference performance tradeoffs" (latency vs memory vs cost). Jamal volunteer to draft loop tweak.
   - Quick win: remove redundant take-home test for candidates who pass a timed pairing.
3) Interviewer capacity & scheduling (7m)
   - Ask PLs to nominate 2 rotating interviewers for next 3 weeks to cover final rounds.
   - Constraint: SRE on-call weeks (see calendar link) — avoid scheduling heavy interviews those weeks.
4) Offers / comp approvals (5m)
   - Process gap: offers stall for comp committee review >48h. Suggest auto-escalation to hiring leader after 24h.
5) Debrief cadence & quality signals (8m)
   - Debrief template (quick capture): "strengths / risks / hire? / red flags (skills, culture) / recommended leveling / suggested compensation".
   - Add short candidate-specific prompt set for inference correctness evaluation (Anya to share examples).
6) Backfill plan if candidates slip (5m)
   - If 2 offers fall through, trigger immediate outreach to top 3 bench candidates and expedite loop (target 7 calendar days from interview to offer).

Notes to self (informal):
- Keep the meeting <35m, triage only. Save deep ops discussion for follow-up 30m with Finance + Eng PLs.
- Bring concrete ask to each owner (dates & fallback).
- Remind PLs of Q1 hiring funnel metrics (time-to-offer, acceptance rate).

Candidate funnel snapshot (rough):
- Platform: 1 offer out, 2 final loop, 3 onscreen/phone screens.
- Serving Runtime: 2 final loop, 4 initial screens.
- DevDX: 0 offers out, 3 final loop, 0 pending comp.

Proposed micro-decisions for this week (my notes + owners):
- Approve expedited comp approval flow for Platform senior ICs (Owner: Priya; due Thu).
- Adopt short inference rubric for runtime loop and remove take-home for paired-coding passers (Owner: Jamal; draft by Tue).
- Create interviewer schedule block for next 3 weeks and publish (Owner: PLs; Lucas to chase).
- Draft escalation email for stalled offers (Owner: Lucas; ready Wed AM).

Interview debrief template (one-liner version to paste into hiring tracker):
- Candidate: [name] | Role: [role] | Strengths: [3 bullets] | Risks: [2 bullets] | Hire?: [yes/no/hold] | Level: [L4/L5 etc] | Comp suggested: [band] | Next steps: [offer/loop/additional-refs]

Quick scripts / phrasing for PLs in debriefs (to encourage crisp feedback):
- "Describe the single most important technical decision you would change on their system design and why."
- "How did the candidate demonstrate tradeoffs between latency and cost? One sentence."
- "Is there a specific skill gap that would impede the first 3 months?"

Open questions / risks to raise in sync:
- Finance runway: how many approved reqs can we commit to before Feb payroll closes? (Need explicit number).
- Interviewer burnout: do we need to pull hiring pause for non-priority roles if acceptance rate dips below 60%?
- Onboarding schedule: can Eng PLs guarantee 2-week ramp mentoring capacity per hire? If not, stagger offers.

Follow-ups I will do after meeting:
- Send short summary + action owners (within 2 hours).
- Update hiring tracker with decisions + deadlines.
- Ping Finance on req approvals and attach projected spend delta for Q1.
- Schedule deep-dive with Jamal + Anya to finalize runtime rubric (30m).

Scratch ideas (for later, not for meeting):
- Mini "onboarding buddy" stipend to offset mentor bandwidth for first 6 weeks (cost & ops implications).
- Quick internal training primer for interviewers on inference-specific signals (20m recorded talk).
- Dashboard widget: "time in loop by stage" to spot bottlenecks (product ask to Eng analytics).

Last bits:
- Remind: check Slack thread #candidate-pipeline for any passive candidate updates pre-meeting.
- Bring calendar view for next 3 weeks to highlight on-call conflicts.

End of scratch notes.
